preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 50 for x in a) for a in test_case_as)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the list a contains n integers, each between 0 and 50 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 100.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == sum(n + 1 for n in test_case_ns)
postconditions.description: The total number of output lines equals the sum of (n+1) for all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) for s in all_output_strings)
postconditions.description: Every output string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 200 for s in all_output_strings)
postconditions.description: Every output string has a length between 1 and 200 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(lcp(s_i, s_next) == a_val for s_i, s_next, a_val in zip_consecutive_pairs_and_values)
postconditions.description: For every adjacent pair of strings (s_i, s_{i+1}) in a test case, the length of their longest common prefix equals the corresponding value a_i from the input.
